healthcareSystem: Healthcare infrastructure severely damaged by over a decade of civil war. Estimated 50% of hospitals are non-functional or partially functional. WHO and international NGOs operate many remaining clinics. Government and opposition areas have separate healthcare systems.
qualityNotes: Healthcare has been devastated by conflict. Damascus has some functioning private hospitals. Aleppo and other major cities have partially rebuilt capacity. Rural and previously besieged areas have minimal healthcare. Many doctors have fled the country.
pharmacyHours: Irregular in most areas. Some pharmacies in Damascus operate 9am-7pm. Look for 'صيدلية' (Saydaliyya).
pharmacyTips: Syria once had a strong pharmaceutical manufacturing sector, but production has been severely impacted. Counterfeit and expired medications are a serious risk. Bring all necessary medications from home.
prescriptionRules: No reliable prescription enforcement system. Medications are sold based on availability. Quality cannot be guaranteed for any locally obtained medications.

restrictedMeds.name: Narcotic substances
restrictedMeds.note: Strictly prohibited. Severe legal penalties. Carry thorough documentation for any controlled medications.

restrictedMeds.name: Psychotropic medications
restrictedMeds.note: Carry original prescriptions and doctor's letters in English and Arabic.

restrictedMeds.name: Captagon (fenethylline)
restrictedMeds.note: Heavily associated with the Syrian conflict. Possession carries extreme legal consequences.

bringDocumentation: Carry a doctor's letter in English and Arabic listing all medications with generic names. Keep medications in original packaging. Bring comprehensive supplies — local availability is extremely unreliable.

travelInsurance.tips: Most standard travel insurance policies exclude Syria. Specialist conflict-zone coverage is required. Medical evacuation coverage is absolutely essential. Verify coverage for both medical and security evacuation to Lebanon, Turkey, or Jordan.

vaccinations.notes: No mandatory vaccinations for entry. Polio has re-emerged during the conflict — ensure booster is current. Cholera outbreaks have occurred. Routine vaccinations must be up to date. Consult a travel medicine specialist.

waterNotes: Tap water is unsafe in most areas. Water infrastructure has been heavily damaged by conflict. Drink only bottled or purified water. Carry water purification equipment.
foodSafetyTips: Eat only thoroughly cooked foods served hot. Avoid raw vegetables and unpeeled fruits. Food safety infrastructure has been compromised by conflict. Carry emergency food supplies.
medicalTourismNote: Syria is not a medical tourism destination. Before the war, Syria had capable hospitals. Syrians now travel to Lebanon, Jordan, or Turkey for medical care.
metaDescription: Health guide for Syria. Emergency contacts, conflict-impacted healthcare, vaccination needs, water safety, and medical evacuation advice for travelers.

hospitals.name: Al-Mouwasat University Hospital
hospitals.notes: One of the better-functioning hospitals in Damascus. University teaching hospital with some specialist capabilities. English-speaking doctors available.

hospitals.name: Aleppo University Hospital
hospitals.notes: Partially rebuilt after extensive war damage. Basic emergency and surgical services. Operating capacity is limited.

hospitals.name: Syria General Hospital
hospitals.notes: Government facility. Limited English. Bring a translator app.

pharmacyPhrases.phrase: عندي ألم في المعدة (Indi alam fil-ma'ida)

dentalCare.availability: Some private dental clinics operating in Damascus. Very limited elsewhere.
dentalCare.notes: Dental care quality varies dramatically. Damascus has some capable private practices. Equipment sterilization may not meet international standards in many areas.
dentalCare.emergencyTip: For dental emergencies in Damascus, seek private clinics. Outside the capital, evacuation to Lebanon or Jordan may be necessary.

mentalHealth.internationalLine: Contact your embassy, UNHCR, or International SOS
mentalHealth.englishTherapists: Very limited — some through international organizations in Damascus
mentalHealth.notes: Mental health services are extremely limited. Widespread conflict-related trauma. International organizations provide some psychosocial support. Pre-arrange remote therapy options.

accessibilityInfo.overview: No accessibility infrastructure. Widespread conflict damage has made movement extremely difficult throughout the country.
accessibilityInfo.hospitalAccess: Major Damascus hospitals have basic access. Most facilities elsewhere are not accessible.
accessibilityInfo.transport: No accessible transportation. Roads are damaged throughout much of the country.
accessibilityInfo.tips: Syria is not accessible for travelers with physical limitations under current conditions. Most governments advise against all travel to Syria.

covidStatus.entryRequirements: No COVID testing or vaccination requirements for entry as of 2026.
covidStatus.testing: Very limited COVID testing in Damascus.
covidStatus.notes: Healthcare system cannot adequately respond to any disease outbreak. Bring personal protective supplies.

insuranceClaimProcess: Cash payment required. Documentation may be difficult to obtain. Damascus private hospitals can provide some English-language documentation. Keep all receipts. File claims with your insurer after departure.

commonCosts.note: Costs are very low by international standards but healthcare quality is severely compromised. USD widely preferred. Currency situation is extremely volatile.

medicalEvacuation.note: Medical evacuation is essential for any serious condition. Damascus International Airport is the primary exit point. Overland to Lebanon or Jordan may be necessary. Active conflict and airspace restrictions may complicate evacuations.

pharmacyChains.name: Private pharmacies
pharmacyChains.identifier: Look for 'صيدلية' sign or green cross

drugNameMap.note: Most commonly found when available. Pre-war Syrian pharmaceutical brands may still exist.
Very limited availability. Bring your own supply.
